title: Python malformed ACK test ignores every parametrized wire value
description: python/tests/schc/test_fragment.py parametrizes test_malformed_ack_vectors with 784000 and 78ff but never references the wire argument. The test instead repeats unrelated invalid FragmentSender construction checks, so neither malformed ACK reaches Ack.from_bytes and ACK parser regressions can pass unnoticed.
acceptance_criteria: Change the parametrized test to call Ack.from_bytes(wire) and assert FragmentError for each malformed encoding. Remove the unrelated sender assertions or move them to sender-parameter tests. Prove both C=1 with a trailing octet (784000) and incomplete malformed control (78ff) are rejected, and retain valid canonical C=1/Receiver-Abort coverage.
